class.name: NetwEvent
class.brief_description: One thing a session did, delivered to a watcher that asked for it.
class.description: A record answers "what happened" without a second query: [member event] names the act, [member detail] carries the decision's own inputs, and [member model] carries the subject's projection where the event is the last one its subject will ever raise. The record is minted per delivered hit and per drained ring row, never per emit, so a session nobody watches allocates none of them. Nothing a sink does to a record is read back, because observation cannot alter behavior: a sink is called for its effect and its return value is discarded. [member event] is one value of a closed taxonomy, grouped in reserved ranges so a later addition appends inside its group and never renumbers a value a saved row already holds. [codeblock] lifecycle 0..15 SPAWNING SPAWNED DESPAWNING DESPAWNED REPARENTED STAGE_TRANSITION CONTROL_CHANGED CONTROL_REQUESTED interest 16..31 INTEREST_ENTER INTEREST_EXIT OBSERVER_ENTERED OBSERVER_LEFT INTEREST_COMMIT prediction 32..47 EPISODE_OPEN EPISODE_CLOSE EPISODE_FALLBACK PREDICT_DRIVE PREDICT_CONSUME PREDICT_EVALUATE PREDICT_RECOVER DIVERGENCE RECOVERY gates 48..63 GATE_SYNC GATE_SPAWN GATE_TABLE GATE_PREDICT stages 64..95 SYNC_ENCODE SYNC_DECODE GATHER APPLY SPAWN_DECLARE SPAWN_RECONCILE SPAWN_CONSTRUCT DISPLAY_RECORD DISPLAY_PUMP DISPLAY_WRITE TABLE_COMMIT verdicts 96..111 VERDICT SEAM_MISUSE session 112..127 SESSION_STATE PEER_JOINED PEER_LEFT PEER_AUTH_FAILED SCENE_LIVE carrier 128..143 DATAGRAM_SENT DATAGRAM_RECEIVED DATAGRAM_MALFORMED ACK_ADVANCED [/codeblock] The taxonomy is closed the way a verdict partition is closed: emitting or watching a value outside it refuses rather than opening a row, so a typo is an error instead of a watch that never fires.

method.name: get_event_name
method.description: Returns the taxonomy name of [member event], which is what a stop, a log line and a panel all want and an integer cannot give them. Empty for a value outside the taxonomy.

members.member: The decision's own inputs and summaries, with keys pinned per event. A gate carries [code]{sender, channel, comp, tick, size}[/code], and a verdict adds [code]{stage, reason}[/code]. Never payload bytes, and never a [Node]: a captured lifetime would outlive the record inside a ring.
The subject's identity, empty when it is unresolved or when the event has no entity subject. It exists because a watcher can name an entity before that entity has a route.
Which act this is, as one value of the closed taxonomy described above.

The subject's projection, carried only by an event that ends its subject. A terminal event hands the last model the plane recorded while the subject still existed, so the worst stop in the system has the whole final state in its locals. Every other event leaves this empty, because its subject is alive and its model is one named read away.
The peer this act involved, [code]0[/code] when none does.
[code]0[/code] before the act, [code]1[/code] after it. An act raised off the main thread is always delivered after, because a watcher runs where it can stop and that is the main thread only.
The subject's route, [code]0[/code] when the event has no entity subject. Rings are kept per route, so route [code]0[/code] is the session's own history.
The session tick the act was raised at.
The [enum @GlobalScope.Error] this act answered with, [constant @GlobalScope.OK] when the event is not a verdict.
